reuse.why: The change reuses month-fill selection, eligibility and sign helpers, shared tag extraction, and the existing mutation and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Production exclusion logic is shared, although the two setZero tests duplicate a substantial database setup block.

placement.why: Selection policy stays in month-fill.ts, budget operations stay in actions.ts, and method registration stays in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their shared policy, registration, tests and release note.

maintainability.why: All month-wide actions share the exclusion policy and existing income and sign helpers, with duplicated test fixtures being the main maintenance concern.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth calls isLockedForMonthFill directly, while the other month-wide actions reach the same predicate through getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated test setup is explicit, and the production exclusion rules are centralized rather than reshaped into separate implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared exclusion predicate gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter; fixed-group and saved-template exclusions remain shared domain rules without caller-specific branches.
